notifications.title: Stay on top of things
notifications.reason: Reminders for budgets, workouts and meals. You choose which ones in Settings.
notifications.denied: No problem. You can turn notifications on any time in your phone's settings.

biometrics.title: Unlock with {{method}}
biometrics.reason: Keep your data private. Unlock Aura360 with {{method}} instead of typing a password.
biometrics.denied: {{method}} was not turned on. You can turn it on any time in Settings.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: You can change any of this later in Settings.

photos.title: Allow access to your photos?
photos.reason: Aura360 only reads the pictures you pick, so you can attach them to your items and notes. Nothing else is opened or uploaded.

camera.title: Allow access to your camera?
camera.reason: Aura360 uses the camera only when you take a photo to attach to an item or note. Nothing is recorded in the background.
